name: work-mode
description: Two work modes for Claude Code: fast and full. Fast mode builds fast — no tests, no Pint, no five-dimension self-check, no framework/docs lookups, no browser checks, no review agents — and records every touched file or screen in .claude/work-mode-deferred.local.md; a UserPromptSubmit hook reminds Claude of it on every prompt (pure bash, silent in full mode). /work-mode full then runs every deferred check once, in order — tests for the touched areas (filtered, then the project's full suite), Pint --dirty, the five-dimension self-check (ui_ux, performance, security, reachability, framework), a security review and a code review (laravel-agents security-auditor and code-reviewer-laravel when installed), docs/CLAUDE.md updates and one visual pass via the chrome-devtools MCP if a UI changed — fixes the findings while keeping the agreed behaviour, look and texts, and switches to full. /work-mode without an argument shows the current mode and offers the choices; /work-mode fast|full|status switches directly. The mode lives in the project's .claude/work-mode.local.md (git-ignored), read by laravel-agents, laravel-nova-agents and teamwork-task (teamwork-task-test 1.5.0+ always runs full); the plugin option default_mode (/config) sets the mode for projects where nobody chose one, through a SessionStart hook. Fast mode can also switch off the security-guidance plugin's automatic Stop review via .claude/settings.local.json env (restored by full — /work-mode full always runs a security review). v2.0.0 renames wame-work-mode to work-mode, build to fast and harden to full; the 1.x files are moved on the first switch. Never installs or uninstalls Playwright, Puppeteer or Dusk for a single run: the chrome-devtools MCP or the project's own runner, and a missing runner is asked for once and installed permanently. v2.1.0: visual work in fast mode happens live in Chrome — first only the minimum the screen needs to render, then the visual edits in a foreground chrome-devtools MCP tab the user watches and comments on (Vite HMR, comments first), then everything else.

default_mode.title: Default work mode
default_mode.description: How much Claude checks while it works. Used in every project where nobody chose a mode with /work-mode.
options: full — tests, Pint and review on every task
fast — build now, run the checks once with /work-mode full
default_mode.default: full — tests, Pint and review on every task
